description: Use for questions about the job market or job postings data: how many live job postings exist, how fresh job data is, how common ghost jobs (stale or reposted postings) are, how often employers answer applications, which companies are hiring fastest. Returns today's measured numbers from Keywordise Job Data with the date and the page to cite. No account needed.
name: get_job_data_insights
title: Job market data: live jobs, freshness, ghost jobs, employer replies, hiring signals
